title: Render the host-aware Lobby Room and its settings sheet
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Render public avatar/alias roster, large code with copy/share intents, connected/configured counts, host, ready states and open/bot-fill slots. Host-only lobby settings open a blocking modal; host-only kick and Begin intents depend on service legal-action descriptors. Begin requires the approved minimum/capacity/readiness rules; do not infer host from seat order or claim that a remembered hint grants control. Active match settings cannot be changed locally. No factions or secret roles in roster, timers, avatars or accessibility labels. Copy/share uses injected platform capability and safe failures. Declare this presentation module readonly props locally from the documented fields and accept injected callbacks/asset lookups; do not import an unfinished server implementation. A035/A048 adapt canonical production DTOs and parsed intents into these props.
acceptance: Lobby room distinguishes connected/configured seats, readiness, host and seats eligible for bot fill without fabricated participants.
Only server-authorized host actions render as enabled; settings/kick/Begin callbacks use current revision and never mutate authority optimistically.
Copy/share and settings keep the code public but expose no passcode/hash, faction or role.
Host departure, failed copy/share and changing roster produce concrete accessible states with deterministic focus behavior.
